query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage a partner-operations pipeline across Gmail, ClickUp, and Notion: create outreach drafts and task handoffs, inspect and update existing handoffs, scan recent email threads against CRM records, and write evidence-supported CRM status updates.
query_ground_truth.query: show me newly received partner message threads
query_ground_truth.rationale: To scan recent email threads against CRM records, the agent must list threads and then fetch the specific messages within those threads.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Help Scout provides customer support software with shared inbox, knowledge base, and customer management tools
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=help_scout. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="help_scout") to create a connection BEFORE executing any help_scout tools.

HELP_SCOUT_GET_RECEIVED_MESSAGES_REPORT.description: Tool to retrieve received messages statistics report from Help Scout. Returns count of customer-originated messages over time, broken down by day, week, or month. Use when you need to analyze incoming message volume trends or compare message counts across different time periods.

end.description: End of the reporting interval in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Required.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tag IDs to filter the report. Optional.

start.description: Start of the reporting interval in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Required.

types.description: Comma-separated list of conversation types to filter the report. Valid values: email, chat, phone. Optional.

viewBy.description: Enumeration for data resolution view types.

folders.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs to filter the report. Optional.

mailboxes.description: Comma-separated list of inbox IDs to filter the report. Optional.

previousEnd.description: End of the previous interval in ISO 8601 format for comparison metrics. Optional.

previousStart.description: Start of the previous interval in ISO 8601 format for comparison metrics. Optional.

HELP_SCOUT_LIST_TAGS.description: Tool to list all tags in Help Scout with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve all available tags in alphabetical order. Returns tag details including name, color, and ticket count.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.
